## Dataset
Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

## Load the data

```{python}
#| label: load-penguins

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

penguins = load_penguins()
penguins.head(10)
```

## Average body mass

Calculate the average for each species.

```{python}
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=["body_mass_g"])

mean_mass = penguins_clean.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean()
mean_mass
```

## Plot

A bar chart to compare the average body mass.

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass
#| fig-cap: "Average body mass by penguin species."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

mean_mass.plot(kind="bar", rot=0)
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Average body mass (g)")
plt.show()
```

## Found

Gentoo penguins have the highest average body mass, about 5,076 g.
Adelie and Chinstrap penguins have similar averages, about 3,701 g
and 3,733 g.
